name: @markforge/web
description: The browser workbench: the engine, its diagnostics, and its measurements, on a page

scripts.build: pnpm -w run build && pnpm run prepare:assets && next build

dependenciesComment: @markforge/browser is a devDependency on purpose: the engine reaches the page as a prebuilt IIFE from scripts/lib/browser-bundle.mjs (see scripts/prepare-assets.mjs), and this entry exists only so `import type` resolves. verbatimModuleSyntax erases those imports, so nothing here ever reaches the bundler. @markforge/typst-node is absent for the same kind of reason, inverted: it would drag in 11 platform NAPI binaries for a capability this app does in the browser.
